test_name: Single-shape dimension registers once, not twice (#1481)::A single-shape dimension appears exactly once in GetRefDimensionLabels
source: Same quantity on both sides: ref_dimension_count for the shape. Bridge: the test's doc.refDimensionCount(for:) after createDimension observed 1 (OCCTDocumentGetRefDimensionCount over GetRefDimensionLabels). Kernel: the probe registered one dimension with the single-shape overload SetDimension(shape, dim), as occtDocumentCreateDimensionImpl does, and GetRefDimensionLabels returned 1. For contrast, the sequence overload SetDimension(seq, seq, dim) returned 2 (the pre-#1481 defect).

test_name: Single-shape dimension registers once, not twice (#1481)::A single-shape dimension created with a tolerance also registers once
source: Same quantity on both sides: ref_dimension_count for the shape. Bridge: the test observed refDimensionCount == 1 for a dimension created with lowerTolerance -0.1 and upperTolerance 0.1. Kernel: the probe attached the same tolerance (SetLowerTolValue/SetUpperTolValue) before registering the dimension with the single-shape overload, and GetRefDimensionLabels returned 1.

test_name: Single-shape dimension registers once, not twice (#1481)::Two shapes each carrying one dimension report one ref each, not two
source: Same quantities on both sides: ref_dimension_counts for shape 1 and shape 2, and dimension_count. Bridge: the test observed dimensionCount == 2 and refDimensionCount == 1 for each label. Kernel: the probe registered one dimension on each of two boxes with the single-shape overload; GetDimensionLabels returned 2 and GetRefDimensionLabels returned 1 for each shape.

test_name: Issue #1588: TObjApplication release path::a single get + release round-trip does not crash and leaves the singleton usable
source: Same quantity on both sides: verbose_after_set_true. Bridge: the test called OCCTTObjApplicationSetVerbose(again, true) after a get, release and second get, and OCCTTObjApplicationIsVerbose returned true. Kernel: TObj_Application::GetInstance()->SetVerbose(true) then IsVerbose() returned true. The singleton's release path (ref counting, double release, 500 get/release cycles) is bridge-side and has no kernel counterpart, so the compared quantities are the singleton's state after the calls.

test_name: Issue #1588: TObjApplication release path::releasing more times than the singleton was fetched (double-release) does not crash
source: Same quantities on both sides: verbose_after_set_false and document_created. Bridge: after a double release and a second get the test observed IsVerbose false after SetVerbose(false) and OCCTTObjApplicationCreateDocument non-nil. Kernel: SetVerbose(false) then IsVerbose() returned false, and CreateNewDocument(doc, BinOcaf), the call the bridge makes, returned true with a non-null document. The singleton's release path (ref counting, double release, 500 get/release cycles) is bridge-side and has no kernel counterpart, so the compared quantities are the singleton's state after the calls.

test_name: Issue #1588: TObjApplication release path::many repeated get+release cycles leave the singleton alive and functional
source: Same quantity on both sides: document_created. Bridge: after 500 get/release cycles the test required OCCTTObjApplicationCreateDocument to return a document. Kernel: CreateNewDocument(doc, BinOcaf), the call the bridge makes, returned true with a non-null document. The singleton's release path (ref counting, double release, 500 get/release cycles) is bridge-side and has no kernel counterpart, so the compared quantities are the singleton's state after the calls.

test_name: Issue #1588: TObjApplication release path::TObjApplication.shared accessed and dropped repeatedly (deinit -> Release) stays usable
source: Same quantities on both sides: verbose_after_set_true and document_created. Bridge: after 500 shared-instance accesses the test set isVerbose true, observed it true, and createDocument() returned a document. Kernel: SetVerbose(true) then IsVerbose() returned true, and CreateNewDocument(doc, BinOcaf) returned true with a non-null document. The singleton's release path (ref counting, double release, 500 get/release cycles) is bridge-side and has no kernel counterpart, so the compared quantities are the singleton's state after the calls.

test_name: Issue #173, instanced assembly STEP writer::geometry is shared: 1 BREP + N occurrences, size scales with unique parts
Issue #173, instanced assembly STEP writer::round-trips: written assembly reads back with the same occurrence count
source: Same quantity on both sides: max_components_under_a_root. Bridge: the test wrote an 8-instance assembly, reloaded it, walked every node and observed maxChildren == 8 (node.children.count). Kernel: the probe wrote the same 8-instance assembly with STEPCAFControl_Writer, read it back with STEPCAFControl_Reader and took the maximum XCAFDoc_ShapeTool::GetComponents length over the free shapes, 8.

test_name: Issue #173, instanced assembly STEP writer::empty path throws, not crashes

data.reason: the empty-path check is Swift code in Exporter.writeSTEPAssembly, before any bridge or OCCT call

source: No kernel counterpart. Exporter.writeSTEPAssembly refuses an empty URL path with ExportError.invalidPath before reaching document.writeSTEP (OCCTDocumentWriteSTEP), so no bridge or OCCT call is made and there is nothing to compare.
